name: PVV

period.basis: TK2025 election programme and parliamentary record up to Nov 2026.

method: Hand-scored against the facet anchors in data/model.json. To be calibrated against CHES 2024 and voting advice tools.

notes.ECO: Welfare chauvinist: protect pensions and healthcare, abolish the own-risk deductible.
notes.SOC: Defends a Judeo-Christian culture; frames LGBTQ rights against Islam.
notes.LIB: Tough on crime; opposes hate speech prosecutions but wants Quran and mosque bans.
notes.MIG: Core issue: asylum stop, far less immigration, anti-Islam.
notes.INT: EU-critical, cut aid; backs NATO but sceptical of Ukraine spending.
notes.CLI: Scrap the climate law and nitrogen rules; pro fossil fuel and nuclear.
notes.TEC: Pro nuclear; little programme on AI or big tech.
notes.DEM: Anti-elite, binding referendums; a party without members.
